title: App links v1
description: The activity deep links one app's printed material may carry (Track B B2, TB-D4 (a)): each link is OPEN -- `<base>/a/<activity id>`, no activation code, no per-copy secret -- because the physical product is what was bought. `base` is the app's deep-link host and is the ONLY host a link may use; while it is unconfirmed it must be a `.test` host, so a placeholder can never print a live-looking link. Ids are resolved against the app's committed catalog snapshot (contracts/app_links/<app>.catalog-ids.json) by deploys/tests/test_app_links.py. The schema is deliberately SELF-CONTAINED (no $ref).

app.description: The app slug; equals the file stem before `.v1.json`.

base.description: The app's deep-link origin: https, a host name, nothing else (no path, port, query or trailing slash). FOUNDER: confirm.

base_status.description: placeholder: `base` is a `.test` host awaiting the founder; confirmed: the founder named the live host (then the QR images are regenerated).

base_note.description: Free text for the operator. Required while `base_status` is placeholder, and then starts with `FOUNDER: confirm`.

activities.description: Activity ids in print order; each must be a playable activity of the app's catalog.
